source.publication: 2025 Maryland Resident Booklet (State and Local Tax Forms and Instructions), Form 502
source.section: Form 502 Lines 1, 10a, 11, 15-21; Worksheet 13A lines 1-5 (PDF page 14); Instruction 13 Line 10a (PDF page 15); Line 11 (PDF page 16); Schedule I (PDF page 22)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = public pension paid by MD (you) 60,000.00 + interest 750.00 + taxable Social Security 20,400.00 = 81,150.00. Taxable Social Security 20,400.00 is the federal Social Security Benefits Worksheet amount on gross benefits 24,000.00 (given). Federal taxable income = 81,150.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 additional for age 65 or older = 63,400.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 502 Line 1 federal AGI 81,150.00; Lines 2-6 additions 0.00 (no non-Maryland municipal interest); Line 7 total 81,150.00. Worksheet 13A: You (age 68): line 1 qualifying pension 60,000.00; line 2 41,200.00; line 3 Social Security 24,000.00; line 4 tentative 41,200.00 - 24,000.00 = 17,200.00; line 5 smaller = 17,200.00. Line 10a = 17,200.00. Line 11 taxable Social Security in Line 1 = 20,400.00 (exempt in full). Line 14 two-income subtraction: 0.00 (not a joint return). Line 15 total subtractions = Line 10a 17,200.00 + Line 11 20,400.00 = 37,600.00. Line 16 Maryland AGI = 81,150.00 - 37,600.00 = 43,550.00. Line 17 standard deduction (Instruction 16, flat by filing status) = 3,350.00. Line 18 net income = 43,550.00 - 3,350.00 = 40,200.00. Line 19 exemptions: Chart 10A at federal AGI 81,150.00 (not over 100,000) gives 3,200.00 each x 1 (Box A) + 1,000.00 x 1 for age 65 or older (Box B, not reduced by the chart) = 4,200.00. Line 20 taxable net income = 40,200.00 - 4,200.00 = 36,000.00. Line 21 tax, Schedule I as numbers: 2.00% x 1,000.00 = 20.00 + 3.00% x 1,000.00 = 30.00 + 4.00% x 1,000.00 = 40.00 + 4.75% x 33,000.00 = 1,567.50; total 1,657.50. (The tax table row 36,000-36,050, PDF page 36, gives 1,659; expected keeps the formula figure.) Lines 22-26 credits: none modelled or claimed, 0.00; Maryland state tax 1,657.50. Local tax (Lines 28-33) out of scope; 2% capital gain tax (Line 21b) not charged (no gains, AGI under 350,000). The Maryland state pension 60,000 is over the tentative exclusion 17,200 (41,200 less the person's 24,000 of Social Security), so the exclusion is the tentative 17,200.
